messages:
Priya Nair: FYI scheduling a Dedicated capacity config change tonight at 02:00 UTC. This updates the GPU pool autoscaling policy (lower threshold for CPU/KV cache warming) and adds a short warmup window for new nodes. Target is to improve cold-start latency for shard-heavy workloads.

Alex Chen: I can own the rollout. I'll start the deploy at 02:00 and watch for any queue growth. @Maya can you handle smoke tests? :eyes:

Maya Singh: Yep, I’ll run the smoke deck and basic perf checks. Plan: spike 100 concurrent tiny requests, then 20 long-chat sessions. Smoke checklist below.

Maya Singh: ```
Smoke checklist:
- Verify pool size scales up within 60s when qps spike
- Confirm median token latency <= 120ms for tiny requests
- Validate KV-cache hit-rate improves on steady traffic
- Run 5 sample user prompts for correctness
- Check logs for new WARNs or OOMs
```

Priya Nair: Great. Rollback plan if anything flaps: revert autoscale policy, recycle affected node pool, and fail traffic to fallback model family for 15m. Alex, confirm you can rollback quickly?

Alex Chen: Confirmed. I’ll keep the rollback PR ready and staged. Command to revert is: `./deploy rollback --policy autoscale-v2 --pool dedicated-gpu-a`

Jon Rivera: I’ll monitor SLO dashboards and traces. If 5xx rate > 0.5% for >5min or p95 latency doubles, I’ll call for rollback. I have dashboard links pinned.

Sam O'Leary: Heads-up to eng-sre: I’ll keep an eye on infra billing alerts during the warmup window. Possible temporary burst cost.

deploy-bot: New deploy ticket created: DPL-2026-378. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DPL-2026-378. Stage: canary -> 25% -> 100% over 10m increments.

Maya Singh: Minor note — the canary config should route a subset of low-priority customers first. I’ll curate the canary list.

Alex Chen: Good call. Canary list ready, pushing change now. Starting canary at 02:00. I’ll update here at each ramp step.

Priya Nair: Timing sync: 02:00 UTC start, 02:15 full ramp if green. 02:45 end-of-day postmortem capture. If anything odd happens we abort and follow rollback.

Jon Rivera: If I don’t post within 6 minutes of a stage, ping me @jon — I’ll be on pager.

Sam O'Leary: All set from infra side. Notifying capacity billing team as FYI.

Alex Chen: Canary -> 25% complete. No anomalies so far. Updating ticket.

Maya Singh: Smoke passed for canary: tiny request median 98ms, p95 140ms (slightly high), KV-cache hit-rate +12%. One non-blocking warn from model loader, looking into it.

Priya Nair: Thanks team. If p95 stays >130ms we should watch the 02:15 ramp closely. Otherwise proceed.

(End of thread)
